docsPromises.promise: lattice playbook_seed_observe --json reports seed candidates and observeDigest without writing stores.
batch proposal dry-run shows proposed playbook proposal manifest; apply fails if observeDigest drifted; candidate approval fails if manifest digest drifted.
promotion status/observe can show recommendations and non_promotable state tied back to canonical seed sources.
lattice playbook_runtime_consumption_verify --json reports active runtime consumption checks and candidate inertness.
health/status shows V1 readiness and playbook_auto_promotion_apply dry-run explains why V2 auto activation is disabled by default.
